tools.name: operto_list_properties
tools.description: List the properties (units) in your Operto account with their Operto id, partner_id, name and subscription state. Good first call: the ids feed the other tools. Operto API: GET /v2/partners/properties.

tools.name: operto_get_property
tools.description: Get one property by id, including its details and current room status (for example clean-available, guest-checking-in, cleaning-started). Operto API: GET /v2/partners/properties/{property_id}.

tools.name: operto_list_reservations
tools.description: List the reservations of one property: status, check-in and check-out time, guest name, phone, email and door codes. Contains personal guest data. Operto API: GET /v2/partners/properties/{property_id}/reservations.

tools.name: operto_get_reservation
tools.description: Get one reservation by id: status, dates, guest contact data and the guest access and checkout codes. Contains personal guest data. Operto API: GET /v2/partners/reservations/{reservation_id}.

tools.name: operto_list_locks
tools.description: List the smart locks of one property with name, battery level, locked state and device_id. Read only: this tool does not open or close a lock. Operto API: GET /v2/partners/properties/{property_id}/locks.

tools.name: operto_list_thermostats
tools.description: List every smart thermostat in your organization with its property, type (for example EcoBee, Tado) and online status. Operto API: GET /v2/partners/thermostats.

tools.name: operto_list_property_thermostats
tools.description: List the smart thermostats of one property with type and online status. Operto API: GET /v2/partners/properties/{property_id}/thermostats.

tools.name: operto_get_thermostat
tools.description: Get one thermostat by id: online status, current temperature in Fahrenheit and Celsius, and any active hold. Operto API: GET /v2/partners/thermostats/{thermostat_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: operto_list_properties, operto_list_reservations · Private data: operto_get_reservation · Public sink: operto_list_reservations.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: operto_list_properties, operto_list_reservations · Private data: operto_get_reservation · Public sink: operto_list_reservations

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
